response.text:
I can’t keep working in the background or send results later unless a real automation/reminder tool is connected and used. I don’t have the ability to continue monitoring or deliver something later on my own.

I can help right now. Which would you prefer?
1) I research this now and give the findings in this chat (fast summary, detailed report, or annotated sources).  
2) I create a reminder/calendar event or email draft you can paste/send (I can’t create/send it myself unless you enable a connected tool).  
3) I prepare a short research plan and a checklist you (or an automation) can run later.

If you pick 1 or 3, tell me:
- Topic and specific questions to answer
- How deep (quick summary, 1–2 page report, or literature review)
- Preferred sources or types (news, academic, official agencies)
- Deadline/time by which you need it today (e.g., “by 5 PM ET”)
- Output format (bullets, narrative, slide points)

Tell me how you want to proceed and I’ll start.
